about: The mutant ledger of scripts/gs25-move-std-api: edits of the move that TestMoveAppliesToTheOldLayout must kill (GS25).

mutants.name: gs25-move-skips-go-files
mutants.rule: Every Go file of std but embed.go moves to stdlib.

mutants.name: gs25-embed-lines-kept
mutants.rule: The embed lines and their variable leave stdlib.

mutants.name: gs25-sources-unread
mutants.rule: stdlib reads the embedded files as std.Sources.

mutants.name: gs25-package-unrenamed
mutants.rule: The moved files are package stdlib and stdlib_test.

mutants.name: gs25-importer-kept
mutants.rule: An importer of std imports stdlib.
